outline: A special project in the area of artificial intelligence will be assigned to students. Students are required to complete the project independently.
schedule: Students are required to report project completion progress every 2 weeks. An oral presentation along with a written report are required by the end of semester.
assessment: The grading is based on the project oral presentation and written report.
